description: Zarya (UAC-0109), a pro-Russian hacktivist group emerged in March 2022. Initially part of Killnet's special forces but now independent, Zarya primarily engages in DoS attacks, website defacements, and data leaks targeting government agencies, service providers, critical infrastructure, and civil employees globally.
